taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Trusted Types policy creation and trust at DOM injection sinks
controls.source_trace: Trace an attacker-controlled value through createHTML/createScriptURL or the default policy into the protected sink. Determine whether the factory sanitizes the actual context or merely wraps input.
controls.implementation_branch: Identify which factory and output type reaches the sink: TrustedHTML is not TrustedScriptURL. An unsafe default policy can convert raw strings and must be traced separately from named factories. Policy-name allowlisting controls factory creation; it does not certify that the approved factory sanitizes its input.
controls.operational_method: Record the sink type, assignment result/exception, selected default or named factory and resulting DOM or script URL. A raw string TypeError is different from a default policy transforming the same input into an accepted typed value. Exercise the real factory on legitimate content and an inert untrusted marker; policy creation or a TrustedHTML label alone supplies no sanitization oracle.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned DOM fixture with a benign execution marker and legitimate rich content; compare raw strings with values produced by the real policy factory.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A TrustedHTML object is not proof of sanitization. An unsupported browser or unenforced policy cannot prove the protected configuration failed.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain policy creation and repair the factory/consumer, then verify rejected untrusted markup and preserved intended rendering.
